TagLibSharp 2.3.0 - Source Verification
========================================

SignalSort ships the unmodified TagLibSharp.dll from the official NuGet
package, and includes the complete corresponding source for that exact
version in this release.

Binary verification
-------------------
Shipped file:    TagLibSharp.dll (next to SignalSort.exe)
SHA256:          DAD93B152D55CF6A58B2037BCF9DD34B45D87761FE5ED61A232B3D4641D2A5D3
Identical to:    lib/netstandard2.0/TagLibSharp.dll from the official
                 taglibsharp 2.3.0 NuGet package (package is
                 Authenticode-signed by the publisher).

Source verification
-------------------
Included archive: TagLibSharp-2.3.0-source.zip
Official source:  https://github.com/mono/taglib-sharp
                  tag "TaglibSharp-2.3.0.0"
                  (https://github.com/mono/taglib-sharp/archive/refs/tags/TaglibSharp-2.3.0.0.zip)
SHA256 of the official archive:
                  D154D28547EEC98D52EF38838055E0DD716571AAF0E7C18E0DF08A99C6A3DF33

License
-------
TagLibSharp is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1
(LGPL-2.1-only). The complete license text is provided in this release as
licenses/TagLibSharp-LGPL-2.1.txt and inside this archive.

Using a modified version of the library
---------------------------------------
1. Replace TagLibSharp.dll next to SignalSort.exe with your modified build.
2. Or rebuild SignalSort from its source repository against a modified
   TagLibSharp: dotnet build SignalSort.sln -c Release
